summary.text: Kay Christofferson is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 53, where he has served since 2013, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A civil engineer, he earned his degree from Brigham Young University in 1982.

paragraphs.text: Christofferson was born in Utah and lives there, and he earned a B.S. in civil engineering from Brigham Young University in 1982.

His career includes working as a civil engineer at Christofferson Engineering and with the Utah Department of Transportation, the Utah Transit Authority, the Department of Environmental Quality, the Division of Facilities Construction and Management and other state agencies.
He has served in the Utah House since 2013 and chaired the Transportation Committee in the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions, according to Ballotpedia.
In 2023-2024 he served on the House Revenue and Taxation Committee and the Transportation Committee.
